source: sanitized curl capture from ChatGPT Web access token creation request
notes: The request is made with the child account's ChatGPT Web access token, not the Team owner token.
The request carries the target workspace in the chatgpt-account-id request header; multi-workspace child accounts may still return a different workspace_id, so callers should inspect the response.
The response access_token is a Codex personal access token. Official Codex CLI stores this as personal_access_token auth, without refresh_token or id_token.
If the Team setting personal_access_tokens is disabled, this endpoint may fail. team-manager should surface the failure and must not toggle the parent Team setting from a child credential action.
